notes.title: Xela Plushies + Free Steam Key of Forlorn Memories + Free Demo Coming soon
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855271/a398adb48afdd355368e173d43844ed82c81a9e2.png"][/img]
[/p][h2]Hello everyone, as always I hope you are all doing well and thank you so much for your continued interest in [b]Forlorn Memories[/b]![/h2][p]

[/p][h2]Makeship Xela Plushies[/h2][p]
Today I'd like to announce a collaboration between myself and [b]Makeship[/b], who were so kind to reach out to me before the game is even released to create the following adorable plush for Forlorn Memories:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855271/2f33bca4357354d046a5cf9bd1674604d77b96e0.png"][/img]

[b][u]Xela[/u][/b]

[b]Introducing the adorable Half-Demon Xela from the video game Forlorn Memories! With her unique and captivating charm, she's eagerly searching for a loving home to call her own. Don't let her reserved nature fool you, for beneath her quiet demeanor lies a heart filled with love and affection.[/b]


This is a great opportunity to help me have a plush merchandise for my passion project, Forlorn Memories. 

But since I not only have a passion for my project, but also a passion for gifting things, the Xela plush will not come alone, but each plush will come with a [b]Steam key from Forlorn Memories[/b]. 
[i]
*The key can be activated immediately and you can play the game as soon as it is released.[/i]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855271/1e29e62d160ea1f8f7892de2f19d388aafd9c224.png"][/img]

If the plush campaign is a success, I will also make plush giveaways on Forlorn Memories' Discord server and add a Xela plush to the game as a decoration [i](may differ from Makeship’s Xela plush design)[/i], but it will be available for everyone. This way you can decorate your airship home with your own Xela plush, even if you didn't get the Xela plush from the campaign or a giveaway.



[b]In case you are interested you can find Xela's Plush campaign page [/b][url="https://www.makeship.com/products/xela-plush"]here![/url]



[/p][h2]Free Steam Demo coming soon[/h2][p]
Besides that I also have some exciting news to share. A free demo of Forlorn Memories will be released very soon via Steam, itch.io and Forlorn Memories' website as I've finally included everything I wanted the demo to have, and the progress you make in the demo will be able to be carried over into the finished game once the game is released. 

Besides that I plan to continuously update the demo with new content and bug fixes. But I will share more details about the exact release date of the demo in one of my next announcement posts.



In the meantime if you haven't already, feel free to wishlist [b]Forlorn Memories[/b] and In case you own a [b]Discord[/b] account feel free to join [url="https://discord.com/invite/H9BA9fngeV"] Forlorn Memories' Discord Server[/url] as well!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2124500/Forlorn_Memories/"][/dynamiclink]



[/p][h3]Thanks for reading and I hope you have a wonderful day![/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855271/37cc548a8c23703c6a2a06b86f0f024d111f985b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Forlorn Memories' Kickstarter Pre-Launch page is up!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855271/a398adb48afdd355368e173d43844ed82c81a9e2.png"][/img]
[/p][h2]Hello everyone![/h2][p]
First of all, since this is the first announcement of [b]Forlorn Memories[/b], I want to thank you all from the bottom of my heart for all the kind words and support for [b]Forlorn Memories[/b]! 

[b]Forlorn Memories[/b] definitely wouldn't be the same without all of you!

For the people who don't know me: My name is [b]Alex[/b], I used to work as a freelancer until I decided to develop my own love letter to the RPG genre: [b]Forlorn Memories[/b], a story-rich steampunk fantasy retro-inspired RPG with monster catching, life and dating sim elements. 


[/p][h2]Upcoming Crowdfunding Campaign[/h2][p]
To make [b]Forlorn Memories[/b] what I've always strived for, I'll be launching a crowdfunding campaign for [b]Forlorn Memories[/b] on [u]July 28[/u] which will run until the end of August.

During the campaign, backers will be able to obtain the game at a lower price than when it comes out. 

There will also be exclusive Campaign rewards, character reveals and feature reveals but also a few surprises. 

The campaign will also offer limited Early Bird pledge tiers so signing up to receive the notification when Forlorn Memories' campaign launches is recommended!

[b]In case you are interested feel free to click the link below so you can be notified when the campaign goes live![/b]

[url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/forlorn-memories/forlorn-memories"] Link to the Kickstarter Campaign [/url]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855271/0ac764c55f93a399235359464915ea07a2455162.png"][/img]

In the meantime if you haven't already, feel free to wishlist [b]Forlorn Memories[/b] and In case you own a [b]Discord[/b] account feel free to join [url="https://discord.com/invite/H9BA9fngeV"] Forlorn Memories' Discord Server[/url] as well!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2124500/Forlorn_Memories/"][/dynamiclink]



[/p][h3]Thanks for reading and have a wonderful day![/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855271/dc7f0e731c0f3d13ebf1a4c57ac7521ff8b2d494.png"][/img][/p]
